pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with star-like, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit multi-lobed extensions, while ventral patches transition toward smaller, more rounded sub-geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a non-uniform topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the corridors increases notably toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the superior neck and shoulder margin, indicating short, dense mane hair.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) are present on the subject: one positioned medially on the mid-flank and a second positioned ventrally on the anterior shoulder region.
